يغتربون (form VIII)
# يَغْتَرِبُونَ (yaḡtaribūna) /jaɣ.ta.ri.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# يُغْتَرَبُونَ (yuḡtarabūna) /juɣ.ta.ra.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
